messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — high 5xx rate observed for venturis-prod /v1/generate across eu-west-1 dedicated pool. 5xx spike (p95) starting ~7123456789. Paging oncall: https://pd.example/incident/VENT-7123 :rotating_light:

sam: I’m on it. oncall link shows spike on nodes vent-ded-3, vent-ded-4. Logs show KV cache misses and increased tail latency.

alex: jumping in — grabbing live traces. any customer impact yet?

maria: seeing ~30% of requests returning 502/503, ramping. prefix cache eviction noise + oom retries on node 4. scaling is healthy but serving runtime is failing fast on some batches.

olivia: heads-up — Venturis (Tier-1 enterprise) uses dedicated pool; their account team needs customer-ready blurb if we confirm impact. @ben @rachel can you standby for outreach?

sam: quick mitigation plan: 1) circuit-break traffic from vent-ded-4 2) roll traffic to vent-ded-1/2 3) enable fallback model variant (quantized v1.2) for degraded requests 4) throttle batch sizes to reduce OOM risk. Applying step 1 now.

alex: step 1 done — cordoned vent-ded-4 (drain + no new connections). errors down ~12% in last 60s.

maria: initiating fallback config: set model_fallback: true for route /v1/generate for Venturis orgs.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigation in progress — cordoned node vent-ded-4; fallback variant enabled for affected routing. Monitoring for error rate stabilization.

ben: Drafting customer notification for Venturis — keeping it concise and action-oriented. Posting draft here for review: 

```
Hi Venturis team —

We're investigating elevated errors affecting requests to our /v1/generate endpoint in eu-west-1 on your dedicated capacity. We have cordoned one node and applied an automatic fallback to a compatible model variant to keep requests flowing. You may see transient 5xx errors or slightly changed latency while we complete mitigation. No data exposure is suspected. We will follow up with a timeline and root-cause once we have confirmation. \n
Immediate impact: Intermittent failed requests and occasional increased latency for generation workloads.
What we did: Cordoned a failing node, rolled traffic to healthy nodes, enabled fallback model variant.
Next steps: Run post-rollback health checks, collect logs and traces, perform a controlled reintegration of the cordoned node.
ETA for stable service: monitoring; initial stabilization seen within minutes.

Contacts: Olivia (Account Lead) and Ben (Customer Success) are on the thread.
Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you updated.
```

olivia: short + clear. change "No data exposure is suspected" -> "No customer data exposure detected." Also add a line about follow-up ticket.

ben: updated: replaced line as suggested and added: "We’ve opened ticket #VENT-8904 for tracking and will share the postmortem."

alex: ops note for internal comms — include affected account list and routing plan snippet: 

Affected accounts: [Venturis Inc. (venturis@corp), Acera Labs (acera@corp) — shared nodes], Dedicated nodes: vent-ded-1, vent-ded-2, vent-ded-3 (cordoned: vent-ded-4).
Routing plan: route policy -> prefer vent-ded-1/2; fallback to quantized-v1.2 when 5xx detected; circuit-break vent-ded-4 until health-check passes.

maria: logs to attach for postmortem: /var/logs/serving/vent-ded-4/2026-03-17.log (OOM stack), kvcache-metrics-317.csv, trace-sample-vent-7123.json. I’ll snapshot and upload to the incident folder.

sam: can someone post a short status page update we can link from the customer message? Draft below: 

```
Status: Degraded — Our team is investigating elevated errors affecting generation requests in eu-west-1 for some dedicated customers. We have cordoned a failing node and enabled a fallback model variant to reduce customer impact. Updates at 15-minute cadence.
```

ben: approved for customer-facing link. I’ll send the message to Venturis and cc Olivia; will use the status page link you posted.

olivia: please also route any incoming Venturis escalation to my Slack DM and to rachel@redwood for urgent account coordination.

rachel: on standby. prepping template for any executive escalation: one-line incident blurb + expected mitigation timeline + next checkpoint.

incident-bot: Next on-call handoff reminder: sam -> alex at 7134056789 UTC. Please acknowledge in-thread if you are taking lead after hour.

sam: acknowledged, I’ll stay until alex officially takes over.

alex: taking over lead now. continuing trace collection and health checks. current error rate down from 30% -> 8% since cordon. continuing to monitor for 30m before reintegration. :thumbsup:

ben: Venturis notified. sent copy + status page link + ticket #VENT-8904. Customer asked for ETA; I gave the "monitoring; initial stabilization seen" line and said we’ll update in 15 mins.

maria: further note — storage GC on vent-ded-4 saturated during replays; need to adjust GC bump threshold before reintegrate. Logging this for the postmortem.

alex: logging timeline and actions in incident doc. will post final summary once we confirm stable for 30m.

sam: thanks team — keeping public status updates every 15m.

incident-bot: Incident update 7123456789: mitigation applied; cordoned node vent-ded-4; fallback model enabled. Error rate reducing. Assigned owners: alex (lead), maria (runtime), ben (cs/comm), olivia (account).
